register struct layout and field offsets come from the official nrf52.h/nrf52_bitfields.h definitions frozen in nrf52_regs.h (offsets asserted at compile time); the S132/TIMER0 reservation and the IRQ numbers come from the vendor IRQn_Type enumeration
interfaces.boot: main() = hw_gpio_init() -> hw_saadc_init() -> hw_timer_init() -> app_init() -> loop{app_step(); nrf_wfi();}. hw_timer_init() starts TIMER1 (TASKS_START), sets INTENSET COMPARE0 and enables IRQ 9 in the NVIC BEFORE the first app_step(), so the first and every later WFI has an armed 1 kHz wake source even when the rail is already high and no GPIO edge will ever arrive. TIMER1 is never stopped in this power cycle: the rail wait is bounded by tick time (RAIL_WAIT_MS = 1000 ms) and the per-frame TX deadline by tx_timeout_ms, both driven by the tick counter. GPIOTE is deliberately NOT used: P0.02 is only polled as a digital input, so TIMER1 is the only always-armed wake source.

interfaces.frame: little-endian; magic/type/seq/flags/ts_ms/n_samples/sample_rate_hz/block + int16 LE payload + CRC16-CCITT; length = 14 + 2*n + 2 computed in uint32_t; rejects n=0, n>114 (MTU cap), >mtu, and any declared length above 0xFFFF; ts_ms carries the SAMPLE clock (first sample of the block), so consecutive blocks are 100 sample periods apart

interfaces.saadc: SAADC (IRQ 7): RESULT.PTR = the whole 1000-sample window, RESULT.MAXCNT = 1000 (no wrap, no overrun); TASKS_STOP -> program -> TASKS_START -> wait for EVENTS_STARTED before any TASKS_SAMPLE; STARTED/END/STOPPED handled in the IRQ; the sample pump issues one TASKS_SAMPLE per 1 kHz tick and waits for EVENTS_DONE. START confirmation revision: because IRQ 7 is enabled in hw_saadc_init(), the ISR can consume EVENTS_STARTED before the arming wait polls it, so hal_acq_start accepts the STARTED event from either the polled flag OR the IRQ7 software latch (cleared at the start of every arm, so a stale latch cannot satisfy a later START); with IRQ 7 masked the polled flag alone still arms, and if STARTED never arrives the arm returns -1 without ever issuing TASKS_SAMPLE (host checks: started_irq_preemption_does_not_break_start, started_irq_mask_negative_control, missing_started_rejected_without_sampling)
